retained_sources.title: Global Self-consistent, Hierarchical, High-resolution Geography Database physical land L1
retained_sources.vintage: release 2.3.7 dated 2017-06-15; mixed source dates per included release notes
retained_sources.license: LGPL as distributed with source archive; retain original license notice. Mixed source provenance; archive README warns of possible source misregistration.
retained_sources.restoration: Download the exact archive URL, verify SHA-256 8dbbe7e071e77e9e75f2d639239099ebca8d5c16d6a07df8169729d49f15cf41 (149157845 bytes), extract GSHHS_shp/f/GSHHS_f_L1.shp and sidecars, then run python screen_gshhg_land.py /path/to/GSHHS_f_L1.shp. The JSON output preserves all candidate intersecting records, shape-WKB hashes and ten nearest unmatched records for every assigned feature. Requires pyshp 2.3.1, pyproj 3.7.2, shapely 2.1.2; projected equal-area comparison EPSG:6933.
retained_sources.screen_scope: Two broad Pacific windows include assigned locations and neighboring Fiji/Kiribati/Cook Islands; full L1 records scanned 179837, window candidates 1463, positive overlaps 45. Land only: not administrative boundaries or ownership. Antarctica excluded.
